'''challenger 60-card Profit''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 15 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Profit challenger LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

Small strat...what can be said about Profit?

== Strategy ==

Spread out and do damage. Disorder (V) gets your characters back, as does Old Ben, Garbage (V), Resilience, and Ben Kenobi. My space is strictly for harassment purposes. DDTA pulls A Gift to put on Threepio (will also keep him nice and safe).
